decisions.reason: As a core drainage component that had dedicated product-page support in both observed years, it fits a long-life B2B portfolio and is unlikely to be withdrawn quickly.
The move from a mention in 2018 to its own page in 2019 suggests growing commercial importance in the strong floor-level shower segment.
Its reduced prominence after launch raises some risk, but designer drainage products still support a premium bathroom offering and are usually not cut immediately.
Even with limited standalone promotion, a shower element with integrated slope is a practical system product that complements floor-level drainage sales.
This product received explicit innovation messaging and home-page visibility, indicating a strategically relevant solution with good chances of staying in the range.
The air-admittance valve looks more peripheral and less prominently marketed than the drainage products, but it still plausibly remains as a complementary catalogue item.
